videos.headline: UCLA routs South Carolina for first NCAA title
videos.description: UCLA takes home the national title after a huge win over South Carolina.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCW Highlight (UCLA routs South Carolina for first national title) 2026/04/05 ESHEET

videos.headline: Highlight: 1-seed South Carolina falls to 1-seed UCLA in NCAA Championship
videos.description: After reaching the national championship for the third straight season, the Gamecocks suffer a 79-51 loss to the Bruins and finish their elite season at 36-4.

tracking.trackingName: SEC_NCW Highlight (SC UCLA Champ Game highlight) 260405
